about: price_trip eval (T1215, row T1155-c). Expected figures on the fixture wire data (tests/fixtures, schema 19), in EUR for the whole party. Each case was priced once with the app's quoteTrip and checked by hand against its parts: beds and days per stop are the engine's day row times seats times nights (the same figure the stays-only tool gave before T1215, 2096.01 and 1373.76), legs are the engine's hop option for the chosen mode, typed fares are added as given. A change in the engine or the fixture that moves a figure fails price_trip.eval.test.mjs; update a figure only with the reason in the commit message. Tolerance 0.01.
